saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 27ης Ιουλίου — «Όσιος Μανουήλ»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 27 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the Greek line is as bare as the Romanian one — «Όσιος Μανουήλ» against «Sfântul Cuvios Manuel» — with the same rank, no byname on either, and the same single fact behind it, that he died in peace. The corpus keeps no other bare Manuel on this day. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence; the page gives no year, no country and no life beyond one sentence, so no `dates` object is proposed, and it prints no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
